name: make
description: Make-hosted MCP server — run scenarios and manage the automation workspace (scenarios, connections, webhooks, data stores, teams, organizations)

requirements: OAuth, or an API key plus your Make zone (for example eu2.make.com)
A paid plan for the management tools (scenario, connection, webhook, data store, team and organization management)
notes: OAuth URL: https://mcp.make.com/v2. API-key URL: https://<MAKE_ZONE>/mcp/u/<API_KEY>/v2.
Scopes control which tools are exposed (for example scenarios:read to fetch outputs after a timeout).
Timeouts: scenario run 25s (OAuth) / 40s (API key); management 30s (OAuth) / 60s (API key).
After a timeout the scenario keeps running for up to 40 minutes — retrieve the result with the returned executionId.
